m5_validation.counting_rule: A sprint counts only when all three gates pass under the same relevant harness, watcher, logging, and config-policy surface.
m5_validation.comparability_rule: Qualifying runs need not be consecutive in wall-clock history. A relevant harness, watcher, required-logging, or config-policy change resets the count and requires three new comparable runs.
m5_validation.imperfection_rule: Worker, orchestrator, firmware, provider, and corrected cleanup mistakes do not automatically fail a sprint when enough valid evidence remains and all three gates pass.
m5_validation.evidence_insufficient_rule: Identify the exact cause before retrying. Correct sample/setup mistakes without code changes. For a verified harness, watcher, or required-logging diagnostic gap, implement the smallest passive diagnostic change, review it, smoke test it, refreeze, and reset the comparable count before continuing.
m5_validation.runtime_isolation: Use only real E2E workers, the native harness blocking wait, and the deterministic diagnostic-only watcher. No runner, wrapper, relay, watcher subagent, evaluator, collaboration notification, transcript inspection, or user-message discovery.

m5_validation.ninety_second_policy: Diagnostic target, not automatic failure. Overrun is acceptable only when gap-free canonical proof covers the actual late window from delivery deadline through actionability and establishes genuine manager work or handling an earlier genuine request. Late harness observation, native blocking wait, idle delay, partial/overlapping/contradictory activity, and unknown gaps are not valid excuses.
